wave_title: State and Effect -- materialize the STATE and EFFECT dimensions (.atlas/contracts/SEMANTIC-FACTS.md#stateaccessfact, #effectfact; .atlas/roadmap/SELF-BUILDING-R4-R8.md R4.8): state identities; reads; writes; transitions; externally observable effects; filesystem/network/process/FFI/build/runtime interactions where applicable; failure effects; explicit unknown/dynamic behavior. This is the first R4 wave materializing two dimensions in one wave. STATE is narrowly scoped to single-level `self.<field>` read/write, reusing R4.6/R4.7's key insight (which entity a bare `self.field` touches is syntax-determined). EFFECT is narrowly scoped to Panic, detected by macro name alone -- every other EffectCategory would require resolving an overloaded call to a specific known API, which this extractor cannot do from syntax alone without fabricating compiler-resolved semantics.

state_model.kernel: core/src/semantic/state.rs: StateAccessKind (Read/Write/Transition/Create/Delete), StateResolution (Resolved/Unresolved), StateAccessIdentity { repository, revision, function, scope, name, span, kind, resolution } -- renamed/extended from the pre-existing minimal StateIdentity scaffold.
state_model.identity_key_design: StateAccessIdentity::identity_key() covers repository/revision/function/scope/name/span/kind -- kind participates because a Read and a Write are different entity kinds even at an identical (function, entity, span) triple, mirroring R4.7's ValueRole precedent. resolution is deliberately excluded: a resolution fact about an already-identified access event. Confirmed both by a core-level unit test and by independent falsification (removing kind from the format string broke exactly identity_key_distinguishes_kind, and independently, the verification pass flagged that no adapter/graph-level test reinforces this beyond the one core unit test -- a real, minor coverage gap noted but not blocking since the invariant IS enforced, just at one layer).
state_model.scope_this_wave: Only single-level self.<field> access is modeled -- self.a.b reports a Read of self.a only (independently hand-verified by the verification pass by tracing self_field_ident's recursion before reading the corresponding test). Module-level static/const reads/writes and any access not rooted at a bare self are not modeled -- would require a source-unit-wide declaration pre-pass this extractor does not yet perform. A compound assignment (self.field += 1) is recorded as an ordinary Read, never a Write -- syn represents it as Expr::Binary, not Expr::Assign (the same discovery R4.7's dataflow.rs already documents for local bindings); this specific consequence was found under-documented by the independent verification pass and fixed in commit b08e027139 with an added doc sentence and a regression test. Only Read/Write are ever emitted; Transition/Create/Delete are declared in the enum for a future wave but never produced, since distinguishing them from a plain access requires semantics beyond syntax.
state_model.extraction: adapter/src/semantic/rust/state.rs (new file): StateWalker walks the full expression tree of a function/method body (not only tail/statement positions). self_field_ident recognizes exactly self.<ident> (Expr::Field whose base is a bare single-segment self path); the Expr::Assign arm special-cases a self.field LHS as a Write, falling through to the ordinary Read-producing walk for every other assignment shape.
state_model.graph_projection: core/src/graph/engineering_graph.rs: the State arm creates one StateAccess node per observation (kind/resolution attributes) plus an unconditional HAS_ACCESS edge from the owning function's node, and a TARGETS edge to a StateEntity node whose id is derived from (scope, name) CONTENT rather than the observation's own record_id -- letting a Read and a Write of the same field (different record_ids, since kind is part of identity) converge on one StateEntity node. Independently hand-traced and confirmed correct by the verification pass before reading the corresponding test, and confirmed load-bearing by falsification (deriving the entity id from record_id instead broke exactly the convergence test).

effect_model.kernel: core/src/semantic/effect.rs: EffectCategory (11 variants) and EffectIdentity already existed from an earlier scaffold, fully shaped as a per-site record; only the module doc comment changed this wave, to declare the real scope.
effect_model.scope_this_wave: Only EffectCategory::Panic is materialized, detected by a panic-like macro's textual name alone (panic!/unreachable!/todo!/unimplemented!) -- the exact same detection R4.6's CFG builder already performs to route a Panic control-flow edge (independently confirmed byte-identical logic, reimplemented rather than shared, by the verification pass). Every other category would require resolving an overloaded method/function call to a specific known API (e.g. distinguishing std::fs::File::write from an unrelated user method of the same name), which this extractor cannot do without fabricating compiler-resolved semantics -- independently confirmed by grep that no other EffectCategory variant is ever constructed anywhere in effect.rs.
effect_model.extraction: adapter/src/semantic/rust/effect.rs (new file): EffectWalker walks the full expression tree (unlike the CFG builder, not limited to tail/statement positions -- a panic anywhere in a condition, guard, or nested call argument is a real effect site).
effect_model.graph_projection: core/src/graph/engineering_graph.rs: the Effect arm creates one Effect node per observation (category attribute) plus a PRODUCES_EFFECT edge from the owning function's node.

bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_wave.discovered_by: independent verification pass, cross-checking every real self.field mutation in this repository's own compiled source (adapter/src/semantic/rust/cfg.rs:101's self.next_index += 1) against the self-systemize output and finding it recorded as READ, then tracing why.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_wave.severity_at_discovery: documentation completeness gap only -- the behavior itself was already correct and intentional (matching R4.7's identical, already-documented Expr::Binary discovery for local bindings), not a correctness defect.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_wave.fix_mechanism: Added an explicit sentence to both core/src/semantic/state.rs's and adapter/src/semantic/rust/state.rs's module doc comments naming the exact behavior and its cause.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_wave.regression_coverage: new fixture method Counter::compound_increment (self.value += 1;) + test compound_assignment_is_recorded_as_a_read_not_a_write: asserts exactly one access, kind Read, name "value".
